newsitem.title: USA: Sage Group acquires Fidelity Standard.
newsitem.headline: Sage Group acquires Fidelity Standard.

text.p: Sage Group, a South African life insurance and financial services company, said Monday it will acquire Fidelity Standard Life, a Delaware life insurance company, from Security First Life.
Sage said it will initially invest about 70 million rand. It said various U.S. regulatory approvals of the stock purchase and reinsurance agreements should be completed by December 31.

"Our intention is to follow the formalized acquisition by the establishment of a strategic partnership with a leading United States institution," the company said, adding that initial negotiations for such a partnership are in progress.

Sage said it will fund the acquisition and initial capitalization of Fidelity Standard from a successful foreign placement of 5.82 million ordinary shares, raising $30 million cash, representing 4.8 percent of its equity capital.
